newsitem.title: VATICAN: Pope to give peace awards during visit to Sarajevo.
newsitem.headline: Pope to give peace awards during visit to Sarajevo.

text.p: Pope John Paul will hand out peace prizes to four humanitarian organisations for work carried out during the Bosnian war when he visits the capital Sarajevo at the weekend, the Vatican said on Tueday.
The 76-year-old Pontiff will give $50,000 in cash rewards to groups representing the Roman Catholic, Serb-Orthodox, Muslim and Jewish faiths as part of the church's "International Prizes for Peace".

"The Pope chose these four institutions, linked to four different religions, to show the different ways in which they all helped the Bosnian population during the war," the Vatican said in a statement.
The Pope travels to Sarajevo on April 12 for a 24-hour visit to preach religious reconciliation to a land torn apart by four years of inter-communal war underscored by religious divisions.
He had to cancel a similar trip to Sarajevo last year because of security fears.
